200.description:
One UniProtKB entry by accession (`P04637`), isoform accession (`P04637-2`), entry name (`P53_HUMAN`) or uniprot.org entry URL: recommended protein name with every synonym, gene names with synonyms, organism and lineage, curated function, subcellular location (per isoform, with topology and ECO evidence codes marking experimental, by-similarity or automatic assertions), GO terms with evidence, disease associations with OMIM numbers, sequence length and mass, and PDB, AlphaFold, ChEMBL, Ensembl, NCBI Gene and HGNC cross-references. Secondary (merged) accessions and entry names resolve to the current entry. Unknown and deleted accessions are `not_found`.

reviewed_only.description: Only reviewed Swiss-Prot entries (default). false also returns unreviewed TrEMBL entries, which can be many per gene.

200.description:
Map up to 50 gene symbols, or Ensembl, NCBI Gene, PDB or ChEMBL identifiers, to UniProtKB accessions in one call. Gene symbols match primary gene names, gene synonyms (`P53` finds TP53), ordered locus and ORF names, and `matched_on` says which; identifier sources match the entry's cross-references (Ensembl gene, transcript or protein IDs, with or without version). Reviewed Swiss-Prot entries only by default and listed first. Inputs without a match are listed in `unmatched`; when nothing matches the result is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description: Start here to find the UniProt accession of a protein or gene ("human CD52", "insulin receptor", `gene_exact:TP53`), then call `get` for its function, subcellular location with evidence, GO terms, diseases and cross-references. For a list of gene symbols, `map_ids` resolves them in one call.

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page. Repeat the same query, organism, reviewed and limit with it.

limit.description:
Results per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 10.

organism.description: Restrict to an organism: an NCBI taxonomy ID (`9606` for human, `10090` mouse, `562` E. coli with all strains) or a name (`Homo sapiens`, `human`).

query.description: Free text or UniProt query syntax (uniprot.org/help/query-fields), e.g. `CD52`, `insulin receptor`, `gene_exact:TP53`, `protein_name:"CAMPATH-1 antigen"`, `cc_scl_term:SL-0039` (subcellular location term), `cc_disease:"Li-Fraumeni syndrome"`, `go:0005886`, `ec:2.7.11.1`, combined with AND/OR/NOT.

reviewed.description: true: only reviewed Swiss-Prot entries (curated, the usual choice); false: only unreviewed TrEMBL entries. Omit for both.

200.description:
Search UniProtKB, the UniProt protein knowledgebase, by free text (gene, protein or disease names) or UniProt query syntax, optionally restricted to an organism (NCBI taxonomy ID or name, including descendant strains) and to reviewed Swiss-Prot or unreviewed TrEMBL entries. Each result has the accession, entry name, review status, recommended protein name with its synonyms, gene name with synonyms, organism, length, annotation score, protein existence level and the curated subcellular location terms. Results come in UniProt's relevance order, `total_count` is the full hit count, and `next_cursor` pages onward. An empty result is a valid empty page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accession` | string | Primary UniProtKB accession; pass it to `get`. |
| `annotation_score` | number | UniProt annotation score, 1 (least) to 5 (best annotated). |
| `entry_name` | string | UniProtKB entry name (mnemonic), e.g. `CD52_HUMAN`. |
| `gene_name` | string | Primary gene name of the first gene; null for entries without a gene name. |
| `gene_synonyms` | string[] | Gene name synonyms. |
| `length` | number | Sequence length in amino acids. |
| `license` | string | License of this record's data. |
| `organism` | object |  |
| `protein_existence` | string | Protein existence level, e.g. `1: Evidence at protein level`. |
| `protein_name` | string | Recommended protein name, or the submitted name for entries without one. |
| `protein_synonyms` | string[] | Every other protein name UniProt lists: short names, alternative names, CD antigen and INN names. |
| `reviewed` | boolean | true for Swiss-Prot (manually reviewed), false for TrEMBL (unreviewed). |
| `source_url` | string | The entry page on uniprot.org, for attribution and follow-up. |
| `subcellular_locations` | string[] | Distinct curated subcellular location terms of the protein and its isoforms; `get` returns them with evidence. |
